ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: PepperedApron uses the camera to add a photo to your recipes or read a printed recipe.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PepperedApron accesses your photos to illustrate your recipes or import a recipe from an image.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: PepperedApron listens to a recipe video you import, or the recipe you dictate, on your iPhone, to write down the ingredients and steps. Nothing is sent.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PepperedApron records the recipe you dictate, then writes it down on your iPhone. Nothing is sent.
ios.NSRemindersUsageDescription: PepperedApron adds your shopping list to the Reminders list you choose, so it can be shared with your family.
ios.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: PepperedApron adds your shopping list to the Reminders list you choose, so it can be shared with your family.
